concerns.text: FR-010 reserves a held‑out test set comprising **[deferred]** of the unified dataset. The placeholder leaves the fraction undefined, making it impossible to verify that a test set was reserved *prior* to any hyper‑parameter tuning, nor to confirm compliance with SC‑006 (no data leakage).

The scenario requires the pipeline to generate **≥ 1500** matched entries. The spec does not guarantee that the source datasets contain enough records to meet this count, so the acceptance condition may be unreachable in practice.
